resource: CharacterRevisions and receipts of one Wheel allocation change
allocation_impact: One change writes 1 CharacterRevision and 1 ALLOCATION receipt, 0 items and 0 value lines; a refused or unchanged replacement (NO_CHANGE) writes nothing.
boundary_tests: max=1: a change commits one receipt at one CharacterRevision
max+1: no second receipt; the replay of the occurrence returns the first
